result_preview.title: Engineering Change & Product Item Data API
result_preview.shortDescription: Retrieves and manages engineering changes and product item modifications across manufacturing operations.
result_preview.description: Exposes real-time access to engineering change orders and product item definitions, enabling seamless integration between product development and manufacturing execution. Manages product item revisions, change approvals, and compliance tracking throughout the product lifecycle. Provides robust query and update capabilities for coordinating engineering modifications with procurement and production planning systems.

result_preview.title: Engineering Change & Product Item Integration API
result_preview.shortDescription: Exposes engineering changes and product items for production scheduling validation
result_preview.description: Provides access to engineering change records and product item data to enable real-time validation of production schedules against active design modifications. Retrieves current product configurations and change approvals to ensure manufacturing processes align with the latest engineering specifications and quality requirements.

result_preview.title: Design Modification and Component Specification API
result_preview.shortDescription: Facilitates tracking and coordination of design updates and component specifications during product development and procurement cycles.
result_preview.description: Exposes design modification records and component specification data to enable integration systems to access approval statuses, impacted items, and change history throughout the product lifecycle. Supports retrieval of design update details, affected component relationships, and change request submissions to coordinate cross-functional teams. Enables real-time access to modification tracking, impact assessments, and stakeholder notifications for design changes across sourcing and manufacturing operations.
